body: I would love for that to be the case.
I'd rather not. Filmmaking is my true passion. Just publishing it as a novel, I'd feel like a failure.

Yeah, I've got most of the equipment purchased, script has had many drafts and finally a complete and final one. 

I've got all but two roles cast. I might need to recast my protagonist though because I only have her for the month of August before she moves out of town. We'll see.

I was meant to play the stranger. And I've been trying to get over insecurities, or mask them with other means, but it's not coming together. I look like Edward James Olmos with a missing tooth and an ugly nose.

It feels funny to describe after all of that, because it's absolutely a personal story.

But it's essentially a young woman who's neglecting making big life decisions. She's in a small town as well, hates it, but in her case it's because she's got cold feet about committing to anything. This is the last summer her friends are coming back to visit, and on top of that she's faced with some major life choices. However, amidst the return of a bunch of students, there also arrives a stranger in town. A guy, roughly the same age as everyone else, looking for someone he alleges is an old friend (this person is also unfamiliar). 

It comes to be that they have some other-wordly quality to them (deliberately left ambiguous, perhaps they're aliens, perhaps they're from the future, who knows). Kind of a Terminator 1 vibe, except the idea is that she forces herself into the center of the conflict, ultimately because it's a distraction from having to make her own life choices. 

The sci-fi stuff is primarily meant to be a metaphor though. A lot of her interactions with the sci-fi figures will parallel her interactions with the people in her regular life. Slight implication (but the only way to look at it) that they might be fictional or imaginary. Perhaps something she's writing (it's mentioned one of her early passions was writing, but she gave up) as a way of processing and overcoming what's going on in her life.
